Update a questionnaire from the server

Source: R/questionnaire.R
update_shad_questionnaire.Rd

Experimental. Sends only the supplied state facets. reset = TRUE calls the client instance's reset method. Answer and error lists must be named so module instances and question definitions remain stable.

Usage

update_shad_questionnaire(
  id,
  active = NULL,
  answers = NULL,
  errors = NULL,
  reset = FALSE,
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
)

Arguments

id

Input id (namespaced automatically).

active

Optional 1-based active question index.

answers

Optional named answer list.

errors

Optional named question-error list; use NULL values to clear.

reset

If TRUE, reset active state, answers, skips, errors, and completion.

session

The Shiny session.

Value

Invisibly NULL.

See also

Other shadshiny questionnaire: shad_question(), shad_questionnaire()
